title: UPDATE: Elon Musk Renames SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI for Trump Rebrand

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
SpaceX is adopting a new nomenclature for its advanced computing division to mirror recent changes in United States government policy. Elon Musk announced the renaming of SpaceXAI to "SpaceXSI," stating that super intelligence is a superior term to artificial intelligence. This shift follows an executive order from President Trump that bans the terms "AI" and "Artificial Intelligence" in all official federal communications, directing agencies to use "Super Intelligence" or "SI" instead.

The directive sparked a registration surge for Slovenia's .si web domains, which reached 44,000 in September compared to approximately 2,000 in August, with one site, AI.si, listed for $700K. Reports indicate some insiders profited hundreds of millions of dollars from the shift. Meanwhile, California Governor Gavin Newsom rejected the federal rebrand by ordering state agencies to continue using "artificial intelligence" and signing the No Robo Bosses Act to bar employers from using solely AI systems to fire or discipline staff.

selectedTweets.text:
California Gov. Gavin Newsom signed an executive order today (30 sep) declaring that Artificial Intelligence will be called "Artificial Intelligence" in California.

> Employers can't use AI to read workers' emotions. AB 1883 bans AI surveillance tools that recognize or predict an employee's emotional state, or that collect neural data, such as readings from brain or nervous system sensors. 

> AI can't make firing decisions alone, and AI layoffs must be disclosed. Employers can't rely only on AI for discipline or termination. They must also tell workers if a mass layoff, relocation, or termination is caused by an AI system. 

> The wider package goes beyond the workplace. It protects doctors' own judgment when clinical AI tools are used, bans deleting AI watermarks, strengthens likeness protections against deepfakes, and requires gene synthesis companies to verify their customers and screen what they ship.
